rules.name: Unsafe binary deserialization of untrusted data
rules.category: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
rules.description: pickle.loads(), pickle.load(), _pickle.loads(), marshal.loads() or shelve.open() reconstructs Python objects from a byte stream. The pickle and marshal formats can name arbitrary callables, so deserializing attacker-supplied bytes runs arbitrary code in the auditor process.
rules.remediation_example: data = json.loads(payload)  # or a schema-validated format such as msgpack with strict types

rules.name: Unsafe YAML load without a safe loader
rules.category: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
rules.description: yaml.load() or yaml.unsafe_load() is called without Loader=yaml.SafeLoader or yaml.CSafeLoader. The default loader constructs arbitrary Python objects from YAML tags such as !!python/object/apply, which allows code execution from a crafted document.
